description: Source code for managing SSDP discovery search parameters, including creation, destruction, and IP address tracking within a linked list.

methods.name: createDiscoverSearch
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new discoverSearch object, including linked lists for search targets and processed IPs.

methods.name: destroyDiscoverSearch
methods.description: Releases memory associated with a discoverSearch object and its internal linked lists.

methods.name: discoverSearchDidProcessedIp
methods.description: Checks if a given IP address has already been processed in the current search.

methods.name: discoverSearchAddProcessedIp
methods.description: Adds an IP address to the processed list to prevent re-examination.
